`open-meteo-ecmwf-2-points.json`: a REAL Open-Meteo answer (CC BY 4.0) for two sea points east of
Samar (13.0, 125.0) and (14.5, 126.5), fetched 2026-11-20 with
`hourly=precipitation&models=ecmwf_ifs&forecast_days=7&timeformat=unixtime`. 168 hourly values each;
from about hour 90 the model's 3-hour totals are spread evenly over the hours.
